description.value: Otter Co-op is a locally-owned co-operative with a broad footprint across the Fraser Valley and Okanagan, serving communities from Aldergrove to West Kelowna. The Langley location at 248 Street offers a full-service experience including food, fuel, a pharmacy, and a liquor store under one roof. For a touring cyclist, it functions as a reliable one-stop resupply point in the semi-rural corridor east of Metro Vancouver.
